newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to set new rule on motorcycle lights.
newsitem.headline: Japan to set new rule on motorcycle lights.

text.p: The Transport Ministry has announced that all motorcycles must have a system under which the headlamp turns on when the ignition is on, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
The rule will apply to new models to be introduced after October 1997, the daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
The paper also said the ministry announced that all trucks of seven tonnes and above would need to have a large rear bumper after October 1997.
Currently the requirement applies to trucks of eight tonnes and above, it said.
